inputs.preview: Two figures stand in the foreground of a surreal desert landscape, facing away from the viewer toward an enormous peach suspended above a distant city skyline. The figure on the left wears a dark purple coat with brown pants and has short, curly hair, while the one on the right sports a green jacket and tall boots, their hair also styled in curls but darker. Both are standing upright with relaxed postures, gazing upward at the giant fruit that dominates the sky like a celestial object. Below them stretches a flat, pink-hued expanse dotted with sparse vegetation and faintly outlined hills under a gradient sky transitioning from warm orange to cool teal. Behind the peach looms a stylized urban silhouette composed of skyscrapers and low-rise buildings beneath wispy clouds. Soft ambient light bathes the scene evenly without harsh contrasts, casting gentle reflections on the ground where the two individuals’ silhouettes appear slightly elongated. The camera holds eye level from far behind the subjects, framing the vast scale between the tiny human pair and the colossal peach overhead—its stem curling gracefully into the upper atmosphere—and placing both as central focus against the expansive backdrop. Text reading “GNARLS BARKLEY ATLANTA” appears boldly in black and coral font near the top-left corner, anchoring the image’s identity within its fantastical setting.
